avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces clonazepam levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue or avoid concurrent use; monitor for reduced seizure control or increased anxiety

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; risk of severe sedation, respiratory depression, and liver damage

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depressant effects; increased sedation and impairment
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on enhanced drowsiness and cognitive impairment

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce clonazepam levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for reduced efficacy; no dose adjustment typically required

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive sedative effects; minor CNS depression potentiation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; educate on fall risk and impaired cognition

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel on potential enhanced sedation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases clonazepam bioavailability and peak levels
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; increased risk of overdose, severe sedation, and respiratory depression

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression, potentiated sedation, impaired motor control and judgment
caution_foods.action: Strongly counsel complete avoidance; risk of dangerous impairment, overdose, and respiratory depression

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay clonazepam absorption without significantly altering total bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Consistent timing with meals recommended; take with or without food consistently

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May antagonize some anxiolytic effects and increase CNS stimulation
caution_foods.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; counsel on potential increased anxiety or tremor

monitoring_notes: Clonazepam has significant CNS depression potential; concurrent use with other depressants (alcohol, opioids, sedating medications) requires careful patient counseling and monitoring for respiratory depression, falls, and overdose risk. Regular assessment of efficacy and tolerance is essential given benzodiazepine dependence potential.
